summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: This package is published as a stylelint config but ships an install-time dropper. package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is itself variable-name obfuscated (_0x-hex identifiers, per-function property-lookup dictionaries reconstructing strings like '--version', '/etc/os-release', 'Alpine', 'bun', 'bun.exe') and, on npm install, downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip, unzips it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it with the sibling file math_init.js as its script (falling back to a local `bun` on PATH if one exists). math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated single-line bundle with the classic obfuscator.io shape (shuffled constant array and rotation function pushing/shifting entries) whose network destinations, filesystem targets, and command strings are all hidden from static inspection. A stylelint configuration package has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time and use it to run an opaque 727KB bundle; the delivery mechanism (alternate-runtime execution of an obfuscated bundle from a preinstall hook) is itself the attack, bypassing Node-based scanning and any policy that inspects only Node-resolved code paths.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
